cohomological_adapter.proof_of_kernel_membership: Because ell_J2 is iota-invariant, choose square roots constant on each iota-orbit. Every Galois cocycle sign vector is then constant on the two pairs. Modulo the diagonal this pair-constant subspace is one-dimensional, generated by the 2-torsion partition class T_iota.
cohomological_adapter.membership: xi_J2 lifts through H^1(K,<T_iota>) -> H^1(K,E[2]) -> H^1(K,E)[2]
